Maya (Mktg): Heads-up: we need a compact creative kit for next Tuesday—deadline tight. Deliverables: 1) mobile-first benchmark micro-grid (3 cols: Latency p50, Cost/1k, 8-word quality note) with tiny sparklines; 2) social cards (1200x628 + 1080x1080) with two CTA copy variants; 3) webinar hero + single TL;DR slide; 4) email header (light/dark); 5) editable inbound routing diagram (SVG) showing canary splits; 6) 1-page brand+localization checklist. Drafts in 24h, finals in 48h.

Luca (Design): Got it. Quick Qs: sparklines or numeric deltas? Hero style photo or illustration?

Maya (Mktg): Sparklines. Illustration to match existing bench tiles. Keep copy terse for mobile.

Ava (Growth): CTA variants: "See the numbers" and "Compare latency & cost". Include isolated CTA component in Figma for text swaps.

Priya (PMM): Legal: no competitor logos/names; use anonymized labels ("Model X"). Include alt-text and contrast ratios in checklist. Also provide localization length guidance (EN->DE/JP).

DesignOps Bot: Upload drafts to /shared/launch-assets/4999991234/drafts and finals to /shared/launch-assets/4999991234/final. Tag: "mini-bench-4999". Set permissions marketing+design+growth.

Luca (Design): Will deliver Figma page + PNG exports + SVG diagram + PDF checklist. ETA drafts ~20h. Will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
